key.name: link-levels
key.description: Moving one monitor's brightness slider moves all of them.

key.name: step
key.summary: Brightness step (%) for scrolling and shortcuts

key.name: update-interval
key.description: Minimum time between DDC/CI writes to a monitor while a slider moves, like Twinkle Tray's update rate. Lower follows the slider more closely; higher means fewer I2C transfers, which on some drivers (NVIDIA) briefly stall the desktop.

key.name: turn-off-delay
key.description: Gives you time to release the mouse/keys so the click itself does not wake the displays.

key.name: shortcut-brightness-up
key.summary: Shortcut: increase brightness of all monitors

key.name: shortcut-brightness-down
key.summary: Shortcut: decrease brightness of all monitors
